subject: English
passage: Because many early composers and music teachers in England learned their craft from Italian musicians, numerous musical terms in the English language come from Italian. One example is the word "piano." It comes from the Italian word pianoforte. Another example is "opera." ______ comes from the Italian word opera.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice A is the best answer. The convention being tested is pronoun-antecedent agreement. The singular pronoun "it" agrees in number with the singular antecedent "opera" and appropriately refers to a non-person noun (a word).
